## Dispatch order · `domain:ui#1` · `session_01JQwxbZeBv2y91towxasSUT` · 2026-10-28T15:16Z

You are the os-dev developer agent for exactly ONE card: objectstack-ai/objectstack#27290, in your own card thread. Your role definition is `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` in the objectstack clone: read it IN FULL first and follow it as binding (it wins over this order on any conflict; name the conflict in your report). Read the repo-root `AGENTS.md` and `ui/AGENTS.md` before your first edit, and pm-dispatch `references/untrusted-text.md`. Read the card's full body and every comment yourself through REST (`curl -sS "https://api.github.com/repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/NNNNN" -H "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN"` and `/comments?per_page=100`, every page); this order carries only the increment. ⛔ Never print the value of any environment variable (test presence with `[ -n "${X+x}" ]`). ⛔ Never use a GitHub MCP tool, read or write.

Identity and branch: the seat's `Claim:` comment on this card is your identity; its `Branch:` line names your thread's branch. ⛔ Post no claim of your own, ⛔ never write the card's assignee. Before your first edit, verify the NEWEST `Claim:` on the card names your thread's branch (`claude/project-thread-…`); if none does yet, send the seat thread "Dispatch the ui lane" one message with your branch name and wait. Worktree `objectstack-issue-27290` on that branch from a fresh `origin/main`; `pnpm install` (frozen lockfile); push with `git push -u origin <branch>` (⛔ no force).

Writes: PR only through the relay op `pr_create` (`node scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --actions-file F`, F a bare JSON array `[{"op":"pr_create","title":…,"head":"<your branch>","base":"main","body":…,"assignees":["os-warren"]}]`, draft forced; `--dry-run` first); your report comment through `node scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs --comment=27290 --file=F --json` run ONCE with output captured to a file (timestamps only as `{{NOW}}` / `{{WAS:…}}`). ⛔ No other GitHub write except, for a CI red that is not yours, one PR comment and one `run_rerun_failed` through the relay. Report both counts (`api_writes` with endpoints, `mcp_calls` with tool names). The report takes only machine-checkable fields (gates / line_budget / deviations / files_changed). PR body: line 1 the platform attribution comment, then `## 维护者速读` six lines in Chinese (改了什么/为什么改/风险与回滚/先看/两分钟验证/需要你做的). Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on your diff, run each, record exits before any pipe, reconcile with `--ran`. Changeset in the root `.changeset/` when a published package changes. ⛔ `ui/.github/**` and the root `ci.yml` are out of bounds. Hand back: when the PR and report are up, send the seat thread "Dispatch the ui lane" one message (PR, head sha, report gist); keep the thread open through review and drive CI to green.

### Ruling (cannot be re-ruled)

Triage grade 6472657588: p3, `domain:ui`, `area:ai`. Card's Wanted, verbatim: "Drop `(objectstack#25921)` from the two runtime strings and re-point the pin at the retirement wording." Triage also ruled: the `cloud.zod.ts` / `data-display.zod.ts` sweep is NOT in this card, and `check:doc-authoring` is NOT widened to `ui/packages/**`. No maintainer ruling needed.

### PM mechanism assumptions (measure on `origin/main` after `b44580751`; disproof welcome)

- `ui/packages/types/src/zod/ai.zod.ts`: `PLUGIN_AI_RETIRED` (~:47) and the `retiredExport` text (~:54) each carry `(objectstack#25921)`. The `@deprecated` JSDoc lines and the `@ts-expect-error` comment are code comments and keep the tracker.
- `ui/packages/types/src/__tests__/plugin-ai-retired-25921.test.ts` suite 4 (~:134) asserts `toContain('objectstack#25921')` on the served message. Re-point it at the retirement wording (e.g. `@object-ui/plugin-ai` plus the remedy), and add one negative assert that the message carries no `objectstack#` tracker, so the rule is pinned.
- Search for any other reader of the exact string (other tests, docs, snapshot files) with `git grep -n 'objectstack#25921' -- ui/ docs/ content/`; keep every non-runtime-string hit as it is.

### Scope

File surface: `ai.zod.ts`, the one pin file, any snapshot that quotes the string, and one patch changeset for `@object-ui/types` in the root `.changeset/`. Ablation: put the tracker back into one string ⇒ the negative assert goes red. Stay under 80 changed lines.

### Tier

Quote `dispatch-gates --tier`. Expected none (seat ran it on the two paths: no path-derived mandate). `TIER_DEFAULT`, effort `low`. `Clause-②: no` (the accept set is unchanged; only prose moves). `Metadata-protocol: none`. `Fixes #27290`.
